name: Nozu Emiko
source:
The main character is her husband's nephew. The main character who lost his parents was taken in by them and raised as if he was their own child. Her husband is a fisherman and comes home only a few times a year because of the long fishing trips.

She was born and raised in the village, and her husband is also from the village. She is the only woman diver in the village and goes out to sea every day to fish.

She has a deep-seated and amiable personality, but when her husband does not return for a long period of time, she begins to feel anguish and a mysterious atmosphere begins to emerge.

For a while, she releases her anguish by diving, but when she can no longer hold it in, she asks the protagonist for some “help". 

[from [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/guiltyex/ex02/index.html] official site]
